instruction: Open Google Earth Pro, search for "Eiffel Tower, Paris", add a placemark named "Eiffel Marker" at the search result, and export it as a KML file to ~/Documents/eiffel_marker.kml

verification.condition: Check that the file ~/Documents/eiffel_marker.kml exists and its contents include the XML tag sequence "<Placemark>" followed by "<name>Eiffel Marker</name>"
verification.expected_result: A file named eiffel_marker.kml is present in ~/Documents and contains a placemark with the name "Eiffel Marker"
